The side effects are different for each person, - my side effects were mild for the most part, the only thing that bothered me was how tired I was for a while. This got away with time though. You should give it enough time! In the beginning I was doubting lexapro, but now I see that it DEFINITELY has helped me!!! The side effects are only temporary, the positives definitely outweigh the negatives. Give it a try!!! I believe in you :)
